lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Day one. Across Neo Harbor, handwritten signs and official brackets share the same windows. The circuit is underway.

lines.speaker: hana
lines.text: There are ninety days to build a deck and make a name. Some people come to win. Some people come to find their people.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And if I do not know which yet?

lines.speaker: hana
lines.text: Then that is what the season is for. No one gets to decide it for you.

choices.label: I want to test my best ideas.
choices.reply: That is the spirit. I cannot wait to see what you bring.

choices.label: I want to understand this town first.
choices.reply: There is plenty of room for that too. Welcome.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At the community center, the tournament noticeboard is crowded with requests for volunteers, equipment and practice partners.

lines.speaker: shiori
lines.text: The exhibitions are exciting, but the circuit needs people who will still be here when the applause stops.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Is this about the tournament?

lines.speaker: shiori
lines.text: Not only. Some beginners cannot afford a spare deck or find a patient teacher. They deserve a place at these tables.

choices.label: I can offer advice when I have time.
choices.reply: That would mean more than you know.

choices.label: I will cheer the volunteers on.
choices.reply: Support has many shapes. Thank you for listening.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The card shop is louder than usual. The Neighborhood Cup is coming, but nobody knows whose draws will hold together.

lines.speaker: reina
lines.text: People are making predictions like the cards have already been dealt.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Are you nervous?

lines.speaker: reina
lines.text: Prepared. Different thing. You should be too, whether you enter or not.

choices.label: I will review my opening hands.
I want to see who surprises everyone.
choices.reply: Then keep your eyes on the tables, not just the standings.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The community center pins up the Regional Qualifier schedule. Some hopeful trainers gather around it; others keep working on their decks.

lines.speaker: akari
lines.text: A bracket measures one weekend. It does not measure every good decision made all season.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Still, people have invested so much time.

lines.speaker: akari
lines.text: That is why we should make the event welcoming, whether someone qualifies or simply comes to watch.

choices.label: I will prepare what I can.
choices.reply: Excellent. A sound plan, without pretending the future is certain.

choices.label: I will support the players who enter.
choices.reply: A strong community requires both players and witnesses.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Posters for the championship cover the harbor. Players are comparing notes; friends make plans to watch the final matches.

lines.speaker: hana
lines.text: It is strange how quickly ninety days can become a stack of memories.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: The last games are still ahead.

lines.speaker: hana
lines.text: Exactly. Nothing is decided by a poster. We can show up for what matters, whatever the bracket says.

choices.label: One more practice session sounds right.
choices.reply: Then give yourself a real break afterward.

choices.label: I want to thank the people who helped.
choices.reply: I think they would love to hear it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The final day passes. Neo Harbor turns its lights down, but the decks and stories will come out again tomorrow.

lines.speaker: shiori
lines.text: The record is yours: {{seasonRecord}}. {{championshipRecord}}

lines.speaker: shiori
lines.text: {{friendshipRecord}}

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: It was not the season I could have predicted on day one.

lines.speaker: shiori
lines.text: That is why it belongs to you. Your choices mattered beyond the scoreboard.

choices.label: I am ready for whatever comes next.
choices.reply: Then carry that experience with you. The harbor will remember.

choices.label: I want a moment to remember it.
choices.reply: Take all the time you need. This chapter is yours.
